# go-modern-clear

**Since:** Go 1.21

## Summary

Use clear(m) to delete all map entries or clear(s) to zero slice elements.

## Details

clear is the idiomatic built-in for removing all map entries or zeroing the elements of a slice.
For slices it preserves the slice length and capacity.

## Examples

### Before

```go
for k := range m {
  delete(m, k)
}
```

### After

```go
clear(m)
```
